identity.title: List of Pokémon Horizons: The Series episodes

leadText: This is a list of episodes of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, which premiered on April 14, 2023 in Japan and on March 7, 2024 in the United States. These episodes follow Liko and Roy, alongside the Rising Volt Tacklers, in a search for the Pokémon known as Six Heroes and to discover the mysteries surrounding Terapagos and the Ancient Adventurer, Lucius. Following their every move is the villainous organization known as the Explorers, who have their own goals regarding these same objectives.
